svg.title: Proposed clock generator and optical reference hub
svg.desc: A proposed device role offers separately engineered 50 ohm and 75 ohm BNC outputs plus a qualified optical reference service. It can discipline the selected source authority in Type 1 or DAC authority in Type 2 without defining a third architecture.
